from pathlib import Path

# Load the workbook
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53161/1_53161_input.xlsx'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path, data_only=True)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Step 1: Read Agent Categories table (rows 3-9, columns E-N)
# Find all agents and their categories dynamically
agent_categories = {}
category_names = []

# Read category headers from row 3
for col_idx in range(6, 15):  # F to N (columns 6-14)
    cat_name = ws.cell(row=3, column=col_idx).value
    if cat_name:
        category_names.append((col_idx, cat_name))

# Read agents and their category assignments (starting from row 4)
agent_row = 4
while True:
    agent_name = ws.cell(row=agent_row, column=5).value  # Column E
    if not agent_name or agent_row > 20:  # Stop if no agent or past reasonable range
        break
    
    agent_categories[agent_name] = {}
    for col_idx, cat_name in category_names:
        value = ws.cell(row=agent_row, column=col_idx).value
        agent_categories[agent_name][cat_name] = (value == 1)
    
    agent_row += 1

print(f"Found {len(agent_categories)} agents: {list(agent_categories.keys())}")
print(f"Found {len(category_names)} categories: {[c[1] for c in category_names]}")

# Step 2: Read Agent Schedule table (rows 12-18, columns E-AE)
# Find time intervals from row 12
time_intervals = []
for col_idx in range(6, 32):  # F to AE (columns 6-31)
    time_val = ws.cell(row=12, column=col_idx).value
    if time_val:
        time_intervals.append((col_idx, time_val))

print(f"Found {len(time_intervals)} time intervals")

# Read agent schedules (starting from row 13)
agent_schedules = {}
schedule_row = 13
while True:
    agent_name = ws.cell(row=schedule_row, column=5).value  # Column E
    if not agent_name or schedule_row > 20:  # Stop if no agent or past reasonable range
        break
    
    agent_schedules[agent_name] = {}
    for col_idx, time_val in time_intervals:
        value = ws.cell(row=schedule_row, column=col_idx).value
        agent_schedules[agent_name][col_idx] = (value == 1)
    
    schedule_row += 1

print(f"Found schedules for {len(agent_schedules)} agents")

# Step 3: Calculate totals for each category and time interval
# The answer position is F22:AE29
# Row 22 = Category 1, Row 23 = Category 2, ..., Row 29 = Category 8

# Find which categories are in rows 22-29
result_categories = []
for row_idx in range(22, 30):  # Rows 22-29
    cat_name = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=5).value  # Column E
    if cat_name:
        result_categories.append((row_idx, cat_name))

print(f"Result categories: {result_categories}")

# Calculate and write results
for result_row, category_name in result_categories:
    for col_idx, time_val in time_intervals:
        # Count agents who:
        # 1. Are scheduled at this time (agent_schedules[agent][col_idx] == True)
        # 2. Have this category assigned (agent_categories[agent][category_name] == True)
        count = 0
        for agent_name in agent_categories.keys():
            if agent_name in agent_schedules:
                has_category = agent_categories[agent_name].get(category_name, False)
                is_scheduled = agent_schedules[agent_name].get(col_idx, False)
                if has_category and is_scheduled:
                    count += 1
        
        # Write the count to the result cell
        ws.cell(row=result_row, column=col_idx, value=count)

# Save the workbook
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/53161_4_889cd9de/1_53161_output.xlsx'
Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"\nResults written to {output_path}")

# Verify a few results
print("\nSample results (Category 1, first few time slots):")
for col_idx in range(6, 11):  # F to J
    value = ws.cell(row=22, column=col_idx).value
    time = ws.cell(row=12, column=col_idx).value
    print(f"  {time}: {value}")
